bestForPixelArtFineDetails: Best for pixel art, fine details
colorMergeThresholdHelp: Extracted colors closer than this distance in perceptual CIELAB space are merged into one. Higher values keep fewer, broader color groups; lower values preserve more subtle color differences.
allTransparentNote: All filaments classify as transparent — default layer height set to 0.84 mm (3 × 0.28 mm print layers).
transparentTdThresholdHelp: A filament counts as transparent when its neutral transmission distance (TD1S strand measurement; falls back to the configured TD) meets this threshold. Only all-transparent sets raise the default layer height.
currentSize: Current size: {{width}} mm × {{height}} mm. The shorter side follows the image proportion automatically.
stack: 0 disables backing. Current stack: {{optical}} optical + {{backing}} backing = {{total}} total layers.
layerCountHelp: Higher layer counts improve blend fidelity but increase compute cost exponentially with the selected filament preset or custom set.
detailSizeHelp: Minimum printable feature size, generally equal to your hotend (nozzle) diameter. The slicer default line width is nozzle + 0.02 mm, which is what these presets represent. Regions narrower than this are merged into neighbors before export.
pixelSizeHelp: Base pixel size. Defaults to Detail Size (1 pixel = 1 line width). If set smaller than Detail Size, the slicer's line width must be adjusted manually to match.
simplificationHelp: Higher values produce simpler shapes with fewer vertices
minimumAreaHelp: Filters out small contours below this physical area
basePlateHelp: Adds a solid base plate below color layers
doubleSidedHelp: Generates mirrored back side for two-sided viewing
